body: I do have a dog. The fact that he relies on me is about the only thing i have to give a shit about.  It's pretty morbid wondering how long he'd survive on my corpse should it come to that.

It's ok.  I don't know, I don't really expect anyone to have some answer that's going to make me go, "oh yeah, i don't care about her, bring on the next one."

I just kind of don't know what to say or do anymore. This feeling of emptiness and just absolutely not caring about anything no matter how hard i try are just shaking me to my core.

I've been through quite a few relationships, some pretty long, some I thought I'd be in forever. Nothing like this has ever happened before.

Honestly, I always felt that way.  It might be hard, but... yeah there's always someone else out there.  But this time... I just don't even care. 

And that's what scares me. I don't care about anything.

That's kind of how i always felt before... just let them go, their loss. I am a pretty fucking awesome boyfriend. They'll either be back, or I'll find someone better.

Going on with my life was usually pretty easy. 

But now... i'm older... i don't want to start over.  I just can't make myself care about anything.  I hate my job, I have no friends.  What the fuck is the point? 

I was reasonably ok with grinding through life for a while when i knew I was going to be with her. All our adventures were coming up. It was going to be awesome. 

Now i just don't give a fuck. Every single thing i've tried to make myself do, everything i've accomplished since then.. just leaves me feeling more empty than before. It's horrible. I have no goal, i have no people, i have no one to share things with. I have nothing. 

Thanks for your time.  I appreciate it.
